annotations.title: Check a firm on the KNF warnings list

description: Use to check if the KNF warnings list contains a company, an investment platform or a website. Look up a company, investment platform or website on the public warnings list of the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) by name, website domain, KRS, NIP or REGON. Returns matching entries verbatim from KNF (entity, identifiers, legal basis, prosecutor, final rulings, important information). An entry is a notification of a suspected offence, not a conviction; no match does NOT mean the firm is licensed or safe. Without query: list size, entries by legal basis, entries new this week and the weekly series finwire_knf_warnings_monitor.

query.description: Firm name (min. 3 characters), website (e.g. "tradereu.com") or KRS/NIP/REGON number.

name: check_knf_warnings
title: Check a firm on the KNF warnings list
